body.title: Restore Codex exposure of the code-review MCP tool
body.reproduction: Start Codex with the current insrc MCP server. Server listTools advertises 13 tools including insrc_code_review_step, but this session exposes 12. Codex logs: Skipping MCP tool mcp__insrcinsrc_code_review_step: failed to build tool spec: invalid type: map, expected a string. No review is dispatched.
body.rootCause: Codex rejects the advertised code-review input schema during tool-spec construction. The shared converter in src/mcp/structural-schema.ts emits z.tuple for array-valued schema.items; the advertised packet.reviewSet[].files[].segments[].after.items is an array of two integer schema maps. This is the isolated incompatible construct candidate; confirm its removal resolves ingestion with a focused schema compatibility regression and post-update session check. Canonical packet validation is separate and must remain unchanged.
body.fixIntent: Advertise selected line ranges with client-compatible homogeneous array items and exact length while preserving integer bounds and host validation. Add focused tests for range acceptance/rejection, actual advertised code-review schema shape, and shared converter behavior. Verify build and tool discovery; real Codex exposure requires an updated MCP process.
